definitions.bins: integer query-sequence length counts from 1 through 1000 bp
definitions.fraction_100_150: count of accepted query-sequence lengths from 100 through 150 bp inclusive divided by all accepted reads
definitions.fraction_gt_1000: count of accepted query-sequence lengths strictly above 1000 bp divided by all accepted reads
definitions.mode_bp: lowest query-sequence length among tied highest counts
definitions.overflow_count: accepted query-sequence lengths strictly above 1000 bp
